Intersectionalities because of the amazing and inspirering professor 

"Degrowth" and "Enviroment and international sustainable development" As they where a great introduction to political economy and climate/ enviromental issues, if you come from a non geographical/ enviromental studies bagground and want to work with these issues

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *

1) Go to the erasmus introduction week, its the easiest place to make freinds 
2) Even out you credits in the three bloks, otherwise you will be overwhelmed by the work load 
3) Do a non acedemic course at crea of the USC sport
